_help: The release schedule (js/releases.js, middleware.js, the soon/ teaser page, admin, launch emails). schedule: each date unlocks its items at 10:00 India time, checked against the server clock, never the visitor's. Change a date or move an item here, no code needed. onlyIfReady: those items stay locked, even after their date, until you press Switch on in the admin Releases tab. toys: one entry per item. name is the name used in schedule, id is the site's own id (certificates, coins and Early Bird use it), path is its folder (locked by the server until release). An item that is not in schedule shows Coming soon with no date, unless openNow is true (always open). ready: false means not built yet (stays Coming soon). hook: the one line used on cards, teasers, emails and posts. persona: who it is for (marketing). newDays: how many days a released item shows the New sticker and sits at the top of its section. Release early or delay without editing this file: admin, Releases tab.
